{{Quote|Onderon is our system, not yours.|[[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] to [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]]|<ref name="Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>}}
The '''Japrael system''', also called the '''Onderon system''',<ref name="Soft War" /> was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] along with seven other planets. It centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Prael/Legends|Prael]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']], [[Arca Jeth]] says the system is called the Onderon system after its only inhabited planet, and that it consists of three planets. The ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' however, call it the Japrael system and that it consists of eight planets. It is called Onderon system again in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.
